gate_type: IMPLEMENTATION gate — Generic Reference Connectivity Graph Foundation (G12A)
objective: Implement the smallest generic, immutable/deterministic Reference Connectivity Graph foundation: (1) generic immutable external semantic endpoint identity (authority/source identity + external/canonical entity id + optional entity kind) that does NOT require StructuralPath and never renames external ids; (2) immutable reference edge (edge_id, source, target, non-empty relation type/class, provenance/evidence reference, optional confidence/status/gaps, runtime_effect=none); (3) deterministic graph supporting fan-out/fan-in/many-to-many/cycles/endpoints that are not VF Scopes. Fail closed on empty endpoint identity, empty relation type, duplicate edge id, and duplicate exact logical relation (frozen (source, target, relation_type) identity rule). No hard-coded SH-WTP/PROC-*/PIM relation names; no universal relation-class enum; no BoundaryPort/PortDirection/PortCategory/PortRegistry/coordinator/run-control/state propagation; no G4 semantics change; no containment coupling; no runtime projection; deterministic serialization/inspection.
explicit_non_objectives: No runtime projection to G4 / boundary ports / coordinator
forbidden_actions: Hard-code SH-WTP / PROC-* / PIM relation names / plant-specific evidence vocabulary
Integrate with coordinator / run-control / runtime projection
Infer edges from containment or names
stop_conditions: Generic endpoint identity cannot be represented without changing G1 authority semantics
Implementation requires changing G4 runtime semantics
A universal semantic relation taxonomy must be chosen
Runtime projection rules must be decided
Endpoint equality/edge identity semantics require a product-level choice not resolved by this contract
Production code would need to infer semantic meaning from names/containment

acceptance_criteria.description: Generic immutable external endpoint identity (authority + entity id + optional kind), no StructuralPath requirement
Fail closed on empty endpoint, empty relation type, duplicate edge id, duplicate logical relation
No SH-WTP/PROC-*/PIM hard-coding; no universal relation enum; no G4 semantics change; no containment coupling
Complete canonical vNext baseline + G4/G11/G10/G9/G7/ASSY/continuous/UI/full suite green
Working tree clean and branch/head pushed
